name: Minamisōma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamisōma city emblem in orange, blue and green: three discs in orange, blue and green arranged in a triangle, with a white swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Minamisōma, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Minamisōma city emblem — three discs in orange, blue and green arranged in a triangle, with a white swirl
